summary: Tested Iter 41 — build action-button RBAC bug fix, RAB granular per-section access (backend + frontend), and friendly per-role permission editor. 11/11 backend tests pass; frontend UI verified end-to-end. RAB sections reset to empty at end of run.

minor.issue: When tests run under pytest-xdist parallel workers, PUT rab-sections in one worker (reset) can race with in-flight GETs in another worker (restriction test), producing intermittent 200 where 403 was expected. Not a product bug — but note that rab_section_access has no per-request cache and is globally visible immediately.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/build_router.py `_can()` correctly derives capabilities from the effective RBAC matrix via `rbac.can()` — good separation of hint vs enforcement.

backend/rab_sections.py properly implements backward-compatible default (no entry = all sections) and validates payloads before persisting; save() correctly drops entries equal to the full section set to keep the doc lean.

boq_router.list_items only enforces section gating when `scope` query is present and in SECTION_CODES — legacy calls with no scope are unaffected. That is the intended backward-compat behavior; frontend must pass scope when relying on the gate.
admin_router.get_permissions now returns `rab_sections` block used by RolePermissionEditor — clean single-payload approach.
RolePermissionEditor renders 4 RAB toggles + all resource/action chips using data-testid — good testability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 41 regression test lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iter41_rbac_and_rab_sections.py. Run sequentially (`-o addopts=''`) to avoid pytest-xdist inter-worker race on the shared rab_section_access document. UI-side: /admin/permissions defaults to 'Per Peran' mode with data-testid admin-permissions-mode-role selected; admin-role-editor-select, admin-role-editor-resource, admin-role-editor-action, admin-rab-sections-card (4 admin-rab-section-toggle), admin-permissions-save all present; admin-permissions-mode-matrix switches to admin-permissions-matrix table.

frontend.super_admin_boq_all_4_subtabs: RAB Unit + Fasum + Umum + Ringkasan visible
frontend.site_engineer_restricted_boq_only_umum_s: Only 'Umum' visible; RAB Unit / Fasum / Ringkasan hidden
frontend.site_engineer_work_hub_action_buttons: 'Buka & ajukan hasil' buttons visible on tasks — confirms build_router `_can()` RBAC fix reaches UI

rca of the issue: Previous build UI hid Mulai kerjakan / Ajukan hasil for non-supervisor roles because `_can()` was hardcoded to specific role names, ignoring RBAC matrix grants. Fix: derive `can` from `rbac.can(role, 'construction', action)`. Verified: site_engineer with construction:update permission now sees can.submit=true from GET /api/build/unit/{uid} and the UI (Work Hub + BuildItemCard) renders the action buttons.
